_comment: Featured repos, in README order. Star/fork/language come live from the API on every run; `description` overrides the repo's GitHub description and `title` overrides the name printed on the card (useful when the repo name is a long course-project slug). Setting descriptions on GitHub too is worth doing - it helps anyone browsing the repo list.

projects.title: Peppy Pick
projects.description: AI career platform. A ten-Blueprint Flask backend that turns a resume, LinkedIn, GitHub and a job description into scored feedback and a two-mode mock interview.

projects.title: HalluDetect
projects.description: Catches an LLM saying things its sources never supported. NLI entailment, embedding similarity and an LLM judge fused into one calibrated faithfulness score.

projects.title: Cascading Cloud Failures
projects.description: A dynamic spatio-temporal GNN over Google's Borg trace, predicting which machine fails next about 15 minutes before it does.

projects.title: Realtime Chat App
projects.description: 1:1 and group messaging over Socket.IO, with live presence, expiring typing indicators and read receipts that survive multiple open tabs.
